evidence.quote: Upload the following documents University entrance qualification Copy of your identity card Curriculum vitae Proof of language proficiency, if applicable Certificate of exmatriculation, if you have already studied

notes: The 500 EUR per semester tuition on the DAAD page is quoted for applicants from non-EU countries, so it applies to a Moroccan applicant; the DIT fee page separately states a EUR 500 per semester 'DIT service fee' for non-EU/EEA students plus a EUR 60 application fee. The programme page (th-deg.de/hi-b-en) states 'No tuition fees, only student union fee', which conflicts with the DAAD page; the DAAD page was preferred because it explicitly names non-EU countries.
